info.name: FarmWeather API - Ready to Test
info.description:
API contract for farmer accounts and profiles, role-based administration, crop-plot lifecycle management, persisted TMD observations and forecasts, growth-stage-aware risk analysis, and advisory notifications. This contract can run independently as a mock API with Stoplight Prism.
